## Database Toolbox MCP Server

The database-toolbox-mcp-server is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides AI assistants with a unified, database-agnostic interface for interacting with multiple relational databases. It exposes common database operations as standardized MCP tools, allowing AI-driven workflows to query data, inspect schemas, and manage connections across different database engines without bespoke integrations for each one. This server is especially useful for data analysis, reporting, debugging, and operational workflows that span multiple databases.

description: Database operations MCP server with connection pooling, authentication, and observability
